title: Julian's Trident
description: This Texture Pack replaces the trident texture with an other one!
body:
**Julian’s Trident – Texture Pack (1.21.4)**

Give your trident a fresh new look without changing its iconic shape! Julian’s Trident is a clean and simple texture pack that redesigns the trident’s appearance while keeping the original 3D model intact. This means you get a stylish upgrade without losing the familiar feel of the vanilla weapon.

Designed for Minecraft version 1.21.4, this pack focuses on enhancing the visual detail of the trident, making it stand out more in your inventory and in combat. Whether you're exploring oceans or battling mobs, your trident will look sharper and more unique.

✔ Custom trident texture
✔ Keeps the original 3D model
✔ Vanilla-friendly style
✔ Lightweight and easy to use
✔ Made for Minecraft 1.21.4

Perfect for players who want a subtle but noticeable upgrade to their gear without changing the core Minecraft aesthetic.

Upgrade your weapon. Stay vanilla. Stand out.
